title: WooCommerce COD Fraud Protection — Stop Fake Orders with EscaraPay Integration
excerpt: WooCommerce store getting hit by fake COD orders and high return rates? Connect EscaraPay in 20 minutes — every COD order gets a token verification before dispatch and only genuine buyers get through.
metaDescription: Protect your WooCommerce store from COD fraud with EscaraPay. Step-by-step webhook integration guide for Indian sellers. Stop fake orders, reduce RTO loss, verify genuine buyers automatically. 2026.

content.text: WooCommerce is India's most popular ecommerce platform — used by hundreds of thousands of WordPress websites. But COD fraud is a problem that every WooCommerce seller deals with. This guide shows you exactly how to stop fake orders using EscaraPay.
How Big is the WooCommerce COD Fraud Problem?

Over 60% of ecommerce orders in India are placed on COD. For WooCommerce sellers, this creates a difficult situation. COD increases your conversions, but it also opens the door to fraud and high return rates. D2C brands typically see COD RTO rates between 20% and 40%. That means 1 in every 3 to 5 orders comes back to you.

items.title: Prank and Spam Orders
items.desc: Anyone can place a COD order in someone else's name with zero verification required. Spam bots also generate fake orders on WooCommerce stores automatically.

items.title: Address Fraud
items.desc: Buyers enter incomplete or fake addresses. Delivery fails, the courier charges you for the return, and you lose money on a product that never reached anyone.

items.title: Delivery Refusal
items.desc: Buyer opens the door, decides they do not want the item, and refuses delivery. Or they simply do not answer the phone for three delivery attempts. Product returns at your cost.

items.title: Competitor Attacks
items.desc: Competitors sometimes place bulk fake orders to block your inventory or disrupt your fulfillment operations. COD makes this risk-free for the attacker.

content.text: How EscaraPay Solves WooCommerce COD Fraud

EscaraPay collects a small 10% token from the buyer after they place a COD order on WooCommerce — before you dispatch anything. This token payment proves genuine intent. Spammers, prank buyers, and impulsive shoppers will not pay a token. Only real buyers do.
Token amount example: On a Rs 1,500 order, the token is just Rs 150. This small amount is no barrier for a genuine buyer, but it is a perfect filter for fake and fraudulent orders.
Three Ways to Connect WooCommerce with EscaraPay

items.title: Method 1 — WooCommerce Native Webhook
items.desc: In WordPress Admin, go to WooCommerce, then Settings, Advanced, Webhooks, and Add Webhook. Set Topic to Order Created and paste the EscaraPay webhook URL from your Integration tab. Use the WP Webhooks Pro plugin to add the x-api-key header.

items.title: Method 2 — Zapier or Make Integration (No-Code, Recommended)
items.desc: Create a Zap with Trigger as WooCommerce New Order, add a Filter for payment method equals cod, then Action as Webhooks by Zapier POST to your EscaraPay URL. Map the buyer fields and activate. Monthly cost is approximately Rs 1,500 for Zapier.

items.title: Method 3 — Trust Badge Only (Free and Immediate)
items.desc: In WordPress, go to Appearance, Theme Editor, open footer.php, and add this line before the closing body tag: script src='https://escarapay.in/sdk/escara.js' data-seller-id='YOUR_ID'. The badge appears on checkout instantly. Create orders manually in EscaraPay dashboard.

content.text: Zapier Setup — Step by Step (Easiest Method)

items.title: Step 1 — Set Up EscaraPay
items.desc: Visit escarapay.in, register as a Seller, go to the Integration tab, and generate your API Key. Copy and save it.

items.title: Step 2 — Create a Zapier Account
items.desc: Sign up at zapier.com. A free trial is available. Click Create Zap to begin.

items.title: Step 3 — WooCommerce Trigger
items.desc: Select WooCommerce as the trigger app, choose New Order as the event, connect your WooCommerce store, and test the trigger.

items.title: Step 4 — Add a COD Filter
items.desc: Add a Filter step and set the condition to payment_method Contains cod or cash. Only COD orders will continue to the next step.

items.title: Step 5 — EscaraPay Webhook Action
items.desc: Choose Webhooks by Zapier as the action, select POST method, enter the EscaraPay API URL, add the x-api-key header with your API key, and map the fields: buyer_name, buyer_email, buyer_phone, product_name, order_amount, and platform_order_id.

items.title: buyer_name
items.desc: Map from WooCommerce billing first name and last name combined

items.title: buyer_email
items.desc: Map from WooCommerce billing email

items.title: buyer_phone
items.desc: Map from WooCommerce billing phone — use last 10 digits only

items.title: product_name
items.desc: Map from WooCommerce first line item name

items.title: order_amount
items.desc: Map from WooCommerce order total

items.title: platform_order_id
items.desc: Map from WooCommerce order ID for cross-reference tracking

content.text: The Complete Order Flow After Integration

items: Customer places a COD order on your WooCommerce store
Zapier or webhook sends order data to EscaraPay automatically
EscaraPay emails the buyer a token payment link instantly
Order appears in your EscaraPay dashboard as Pending Token
Buyer pays the token and status changes to Token Paid
You dispatch the order from WooCommerce
EscaraPay sends the buyer a delivery confirmation link
Buyer confirms receipt and payment releases to your UPI
If buyer takes no action within 14 days, payment auto-releases to you

items.title: Will prepaid WooCommerce orders be affected?
items.desc: No. EscaraPay only processes COD orders. Prepaid orders from Razorpay, PayU, or Cashfree are automatically skipped. Make sure you add the COD filter in Zapier.

items.title: What happens if a buyer does not pay the token?
items.desc: The order stays as Pending Token. Put the WooCommerce order on hold and use the EscaraPay admin dashboard to WhatsApp the buyer directly. After 14 days, the order auto-cancels.

items.title: What commission does EscaraPay charge?
items.desc: EscaraPay charges 5% of the token amount on successful delivery. On a Rs 1,000 order with Rs 100 token, the commission is just Rs 5. Very fair for the protection you get.

items.title: Can it handle orders with multiple products?
items.desc: Yes. Multiple line items are combined into a single product name string. The token is calculated on the full order total, not individual products.
